damage.title: Damage Assessment
damage.label: Damage level
damage.minimalDesc: Structurally sound and functional, showing only cosmetic or no visible damage
damage.partialDesc: Repairable, and remains usable with caution

survey.title: Survey ({{current}}/{{total}})

infrastructureTypes.commercial: Commercial Infrastructure (Markets, malls, shops, hotels, banks, industries, etc.)
infrastructureTypes.government: Government Building (Administrative buildings, courthouses, police stations, fire stations, etc.)
infrastructureTypes.utility: Utility Infrastructure (Water pumps, power plants, waste treatment plants, etc.)
infrastructureTypes.transport: Transport and Communication Infrastructure (Roads, cell towers, bridges, railway station, bus station, etc.)
infrastructureTypes.community: Community Infrastructure (Schools, hospitals, community halls, public toilets, etc.)
infrastructureTypes.publicSpaces: Public spaces/Recreation Infrastructure (stadiums, playgrounds, religious buildings, etc.)

survey.infrastructureDetails: Provide more details on the nature of the infrastructure, including the name of the infrastructure:
survey.debris: Is there any debris that requires clearing on or near the infrastructure site?
survey.electricity: What is the current condition of electricity infrastructure in your community following the crisis?

electricityOptions.minor: Minor damage (service disruptions but quickly repairable)
electricityOptions.severe: Severe damage (major infrastructure damaged, prolonged outages)

survey.health: How would you rate the overall functioning of health services in your community since the event?
survey.pressingNeeds: What are the most pressing needs?

pressingNeedOptions.food: Food assistance and safe drinking water
pressingNeedOptions.healthcare: Access to healthcare and essential medicines
pressingNeedOptions.shelter: Shelter, housing repair, or temporary accommodation
pressingNeedOptions.livelihoods: Restoration of livelihoods or income sources
pressingNeedOptions.wash: Water, sanitation, and hygiene (toilets, washing facilities)
pressingNeedOptions.services: Restoration of basic services and infrastructure (electricity, roads, schools)
pressingNeedOptions.localSupport: Support from local authorities and community organizations
